name: Henry Birkin
features: fair skin, dark hair slicked flat, dark eyes, narrow aristocratic face, thin lips, slim build, restless eager expression, blue and white spotted silk scarf
bio: Sir Henry ‘Tim’ Birkin, the most headlong of the Bentley Boys, won Le Mans in 1929 with Woolf Barnato and again in 1931 in Earl Howe’s Alfa Romeo. Against W.O. Bentley’s wishes he built the supercharged Blower 4½-litre and took the Brooklands outer circuit record at 137.96 mph in 1932. He died in 1933 of blood poisoning from a burn taken on a hot exhaust at Tripoli, aged 36.
